facts.text: Serve the mains when Ace finds the dolphin in the rich guy's private tank.
facts.why: Ace does not find Snowflake in a rich man's tank. Ronald Camp is the rich collector, Ace rules him out, and Snowflake and Dan Marino are found held at an abandoned yacht storage facility on Super Bowl Sunday.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Ace finds Snowflake in the yacht storage yard.

facts.text: Serve the mains when Ace finds the dolphin in the rich guy's private tank.

facts.fix: Serve the mains when Ace finds Snowflake in the yacht storage yard.

facts.text: Case closed, dinner's served. Somebody find me a clean fork, and keep the parrot off the table.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Not a line from the film. The Ace quotes on the page I opened do not include it. A real line with a clean theme is 'Hi, I'm looking for Ray Finkle. And a clean pair of shorts.'
facts.fix: Hi, I'm looking for Ray Finkle. And a clean pair of shorts.

facts.text: Shady Acres, where the trail goes cold
facts.why: The trail heats up at the hospital. Ace goes undercover there and finds the newspaper clipping about the missing hiker Lois Einhorn, which tells him Einhorn is Finkle.
